name: Arjun Verma
bio:
Arjun's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for rally racing, fueled by grainy television broadcasts and the roar of engines in local events. This passion led him to pursue a degree in mechanical engineering, focusing on vehicle dynamics and performance. After graduating, he gained experience in smaller racing teams, quickly demonstrating a knack for strategic decision-making and team management. His ability to see the 'big picture' and implement methodical improvements caught the eye of Peugeot TotalEnergies, where he now serves as Sporting Director.

In his role, Arjun is known for his analytical approach, meticulously studying data and identifying areas for improvement. He fosters a culture of collaboration within the team, believing that open communication and shared goals are essential for success. Arjun is particularly driven by the challenge of optimizing performance in diverse and demanding rally conditions. He's also known to champion new technological approaches, but only after rigorous testing and validation. His loyalty to the team and dedication to innovation are hallmarks of his leadership style.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight side part
physical.description: Arjun has a focused gaze and a lean build, suggesting both intellect and physical fitness.

quirks: Always carries a worn notebook filled with handwritten calculations and diagrams.
Insists on starting every team meeting with a brief recap of the previous rally's key performance indicators.
Has a habit of pacing while deep in thought, often muttering technical jargon.
